fusions.name: Done Toying
fusions.desc: A hooking pounce on a target at or below 30% health that deals 20 damage, uses up every affliction on it and adds 1.6 times their remaining damage. For 3 seconds after, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Batting Swipes
fusions.desc: A quick hooked swipe that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Hedge
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 15% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Waiting in the Rows
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds. You have 25% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.
